response.justification: Bogdan is a highly skilled Staff/Senior Software Engineer with an impressive background in open-source development, software architecture, and technical mentorship. However, he falls short of the core requirements for this executive-level role. He lacks formal team management and executive leadership experience, and most critically, he only possesses basic German skills whereas the position explicitly mandates a minimum of C1 proficiency for client advisory and operational leadership.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience developing modern, complex software systems with a strong focus on open-source technologies and Linux environments.
Proven track record in software architecture, including designing micro-services, event-driven platforms, and full-stack applications.
Demonstrated dedication to technical mentorship and knowledge sharing through organizing coding dojos, workshops, and courses.
concerns: Fails to meet the mandatory German language requirement (holds Basic proficiency, whereas C1 is required).
Lacks explicit executive-level leadership, formal team management, and strategic client advisory experience.
Missing demonstrated expertise in UML modeling, formal IT security, risk management, and compliance.
